edges.reason: transfer() forwards to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom() forwards to the internal _transfer routine.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer for accounting.
_transfer performs the external swap through swapTokensForEth before completing accounting.
_transfer forwards contract ETH to the fee wallets in the middle of the transfer.
swapTokensForEth calls the Uniswap router swap entry point.
sendETHToFee pushes ETH with transfer to the fee wallets.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the contract ETH balance.
_tokenTransfer delegates the accounting to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard credits the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard applies the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_getValues reads the current rate from _getRate.
_getRate queries supplies through _getCurrentSupply.
_takeTeam reads the current rate to compute the reflection team fee.
manualswap is gated by _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 before swapping.
manualsend is gated by _msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1 before sending ETH.
msg.sender becomes the from address of the transfer.
block.timestamp writes the cooldown mapping for the recipient.
block.timestamp drives cooldown enforcement and the swap deadline.
_transfer ultimately mutates reflection balances.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned entries.
_transferStandard reduces the total reflection supply through the fee.
_reflectFee subtracts rFee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates tFee into _tFeeTotal.
_takeTeam credits the contract reflection balance in _rOwned.
openTrading stores the router address.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
openTrading enables swapping.
openTrading sets the tradingOpen flag.
setBots writes flags into the bots mapping.
delBot clears a flag in the bots mapping.
removeStrictTxLimit rewrites _maxTxAmount.
_transfer sets the _feeAddr1 tax percentage.
_transfer sets the _feeAddr2 team percentage.
_transfer compares the incoming amount against _maxTxAmount.
_approve writes into the nested _allowances mapping.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
openTrading approves the router through _approve.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance through _approve.
balanceOf converts reflections using tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate from _getRate.
_getValues derives token values from _getTValues.
_getValues derives reflection values from _getRValues.
_msgSender returns msg.sender consumed by transfer.
msg.sender is returned by the Context _msgSender helper.
msg.sender is checked against _feeAddrWallet1 in manualswap.
msg.sender is checked against _feeAddrWallet1 in manualsend.
onlyOwner guards openTrading using the caller address.
onlyOwner guards setBots using the caller address.
onlyOwner guards removeStrictTxLimit using the caller address.
onlyOwner guards delBot using the caller address.
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership using the caller address.
renounceOwnership resets the _owner state variable.
_owner is compared with the caller by the onlyOwner modifier on openTrading.
inSwap guards swapTokensForEth against reentrant swaps.
lockTheSwap sets inSwap while the external router call executes.
_feeAddrWallet1 receives half of the forwarded ETH.
_feeAddrWallet2 receives half of the forwarded ETH.
receive() funds the contract ETH balance later swept by manualsend.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from is the caller-supplied sender address used only inside _transfer.
Parameter to is the recipient address used only inside _transfer.
Parameter amount is the value checked and forwarded by _transfer.
Local contract token balance is computed in _transfer and passed directly to swapTokensForEth.
Parameter tokenAmount is the swap input of swapTokensForEth.
Parameter tAmount is the token amount whose values _transferStandard computes.
Local rAmount is the reflection amount debited inside _transferStandard.
Local currentRate is the value produced by _getRate.
Parameter bots_ is the address list iterated by setBots.
Local contractBalance is the balance swapped by manualswap.
